blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court has considered public prosecutor and Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon’s explanation as to why he should not be cited for violation of the sub judice rule over his comments, issuing just a stern warning against him instead. Ridon on Monday, after Day 30 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, confirmed in an interview that the court has issued a decision on the show-cause order issued against him last September 16, asking him to explain his comments made during media interviews.
